# Nirvana Paws Initiative & Academy (NPIA)

> NPIA is an Indian street animal welfare initiative and upcoming sanctuary & training academy. We save street animals immediately through a connected network of allied shelters, veterinary clinics, and volunteers while building NPIA's permanent Flagship Sanctuary and The Canine Academy.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://npia.org.in/): Founding mission, 4-stage sanctuary roadmap, Partner Hub onboarding, and NPIA's 3 Academy & Sanctuary wings.
- [About NPIA & Founding Charter](https://npia.org.in/about): Organization story, core values, founding leadership seats, and complete 7-aim, 7-objective Founding Charter.
- [4-Stage Sanctuary Roadmap](https://npia.org.in/roadmap): Detailed rollout across Connected Shelter Grid, Vet Triage & ABC Drives, Flagship Sanctuary Build, and Canine Academy.
- [Partner Network](https://npia.org.in/partner-network): How shelters, veterinary hospitals, foster caregivers, and sponsors join NPIA's shared logistics grid.
- [Our Programs (INSPIRE)](https://npia.org.in/our-programs): Initiative Nurturing Stray Puppies Into Responsible Environments—rescue, nutrition, obedience, therapy/guide training, and placement.
- [Donate](https://npia.org.in/donate): Monthly or one-off INR support pledges for shared shelter beds (₹500+), vet triage & post-op care (₹1,500+), and flagship sanctuary build (₹5,000+).
- [Contact & Partner Desk](https://npia.org.in/contact-us): Direct intake for partnerships, veterinary clinics, volunteering, fostering, adoption, and sanctuary support (`hello@npia.org.in`).

## Extended AI Reference
